name: real_coding_benchmark
description: Real-world coding agent benchmarks: breaking API changes, lock contention, session leaks, and framework pitfalls.

memories.title: SQLAlchemy 2.0 explicit commit requirement
memories.content: Engine connection in SQLAlchemy 2.0 requires explicit conn.commit() or conn.begin() context. Autocommit is removed. Never pass autocommit=True.

memories.title: SQLite WAL mode and busy timeout
memories.content: Prevent database locked operational error under concurrent writers by setting PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000.

exceptions: Not supported on NFS network shares

memories.title: Pydantic v2 model_dump migration
memories.content: In Pydantic v2, replace legacy .dict() with .model_dump() and .json() with .model_dump_json(). Calling .dict() emits deprecation warnings or breaks.

memories.title: pytest-asyncio auto mode configuration
memories.content: To prevent fixture loop scope mismatch and asyncio warnings, configure asyncio_mode = 'auto' in pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options].

memories.title: HTTP requests connection pool socket leak
memories.content: Always manage requests.Session inside a with context manager or call session.close() in finally block to avoid unclosed socket warnings.

memories.title: Legacy autocommit flag
memories.content: Pass autocommit=True to create_engine or execution_options to enable driver-level autocommit.
